founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
We're building specialized AI agents for banks to 10x back office functions.

I previously founded and scaled 2 VC-backed companies to millions of users, hundreds of employees, and tens of millions raised from top-tier VCs, including General Catalyst's Hemant Taneja.

Fun fact: Fought goons in a train robbery in Mumbai and got the National Bravery Award from the Indian Prime Minister & President.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
We're building specialized AI agents for banks to 10x back office functions.

I previously spent 10 years building cutting-edge ML at Google and Apple for billions of users. I invented ways to train ML models without exposing private data, built Apple's first privacy-preserving ML at scale, and designed ML that helped a startup go public.
